method: Manual comparison of five actual rendered frames per transition, neighboring presets, and complete MP4 decode

decisions.observation: Vertical bars of the incoming shot tear in from the right and shift left; the bars remain clearly separated at the midpoint, unlike pixel blocks or fine wind streaks.
Vertical incoming bars progress from the left toward the right, reversing the horizontal slice direction while keeping a visibly segmented transition midpoint.
Several horizontal stripes reveal the incoming scene upward, with discrete hard band edges that differ from vertical-bar slicing and fine wind streaks.
Horizontal stripes sweep downward with separate bands of old and new scenes; its direction is visibly opposite the upward stripe variant.
Fine horizontal streaks pull from the right toward the left and feather the scene boundary, unlike the thick discrete vertical bars of leftward slicing.
Fine horizontal streaks pull from the left toward the right, with the old and new shots interleaving at a moving rightward boundary.
Fine vertical streaks rise from the lower edge, producing a soft comb-shaped vertical reveal rather than hard horizontal stripes.
Fine vertical streaks descend from the upper edge, with the comb boundary moving opposite the upward wind variant.
